It is not a Due Diligence Statement, it does not assess the level of risk and it is not signed. The risk assessment and the submission of the DDS are the operator's responsibility

pdf.huella: SHA-256 fingerprint of the content (JSON with sorted keys, UTF-8, no spaces):
pdf.dni_representante: ID number of the legal representative
pdf.genealogia_sub: Each plot with its producer, its kilograms and its share of the lot, and the harvest range of its batches.
pdf.croquis: Sketch of the plots of the lot, with north at the top and no background map.
pdf.respaldo_sub: Its DOPs, its enablement, what each analysis source said and its legality by requirement.
pdf.convergencia_frase: Datasets consulted: {n}. Record forest in 2020: {a} of {b} that measure it. Record forest loss after 2020: {c} of {d} that measure it. Record vegetation disturbance after 2020: {e} of {f} that measure it.
pdf.obs_2020: In the image before the cut-off
pdf.recomprobacion_sub: The nine checks, with the date of the day of issue.
pdf.criterios_titulo: The 14 criteria of Article 10(2), grouped into 11 themes
pdf.evidencia_sub: They are not in the package. The cooperative provides copies if the importer asks for them.
pdf.tenencia_cubierta: Not required: tenure is covered by {documento}
pdf.uso_suelo: Land use by year (ha), according to MapBiomas Peru
pdf.uso_suelo_nota: Hectares of each class of the MapBiomas Peru legend (Collection 3) within the plot, year by year, with the class names of the official legend. 30 m pixels in the plot: {pixeles}. No legend class corresponds to cocoa alone.
pdf.legalidad: Legality of the plot by requirement
pdf.orientador: Framework: Guidance document for due diligence on the legality of coffee and cocoa under the EUDR (MIDAGRI, MINCETUR and ADEX; European Forest Institute, 2026). The document itself states that it is not legally binding and is not legal advice. The table states which requirements apply to the plot and what supports them.
pdf.aproximacion: approximation: the plot is a point and was overlaid as a circle
pdf.capa_sin_zonificacion: The layer does not classify the department of the plot
pdf.capa_no_figura: The plot is not shown in the layer
pdf.por_excepcion: under the exception of Law No. 31973
pdf.descripcion_incidencia: What was found, source and closure
pdf.declaraciones_sub: What each producer in the lot stated in their annual declaration, as of today.
pdf.declaraciones_nota: These are the producers' own declarations: the organisation did not verify them in the field, unless the follow-up note says otherwise. Framework: Guidance document for due diligence on the legality of coffee and cocoa under the EUDR (MIDAGRI, MINCETUR and ADEX; European Forest Institute, 2026), requirements 2.3, 2.7, 4.1 to 4.7, 5.2 to 5.4 and 7.1.
pdf.requisitos_productor: Requirements to be addressed or without support
pdf.organizacion: The organisation and its due diligence
pdf.organizacion_sub: With the status on the day of issue. What the organisation wrote is in its own words; the evidence of each action does not leave the system.
pdf.canal: Contact of the complaints and grievance channel
pdf.sin_actuaciones: The organisation has no current actions.
pdf.actuaciones_alcanzaron: Actions of the organisation that reached them

anexo.nota_general: Help for the importer with the due diligence statement fields that come from this flow, in the order of Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 (consolidated text of 18/09/2026). It is not a submission to TRACES and does not use its interface.
anexo.a_confirmar: to be confirmed by the operator
anexo.punto_1: Operator’s name, address and, in the event of relevant commodities and relevant products entering or leaving the market, the Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number in accordance with Article 9 of Regulation (EU) No 952/2013.
anexo.punto_2: Harmonised System code, free-text description, including the trade name as well as, where applicable, the full scientific name, and quantity of the relevant product that the operator intends to place on the market or export.
anexo.punto_3: Country of production and the geolocation of all plots of land where the relevant commodities were produced.
anexo.punto_5: Text of point 5 of Annex II, with which the operator states that due diligence was carried out and the level of risk found.
anexo.punto_6: Signature in the following format: ‘Signed for and on behalf of: / Date: / Name and function: Signature:’.
anexo.complementaria: Information under Article 9(1) of the Regulation that also comes from this flow.
anexo.intervalo_cosecha: Date or time range of production (Art. 9(1), point (d)): harvest range of the batches of the lot.
anexo.proveedor: Name, postal address and email address of the business that supplied the products (Art. 9(1), point (e)): the exporting cooperative.
anexo.geojson: The geolocation is in the file parcelas.geojson of the package.

- anexo_ii.json: the due diligence statement fields that come from this flow, in the order of Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2023/1115. The risk statement and the signature are for the operator.
- hallazgos.json: the structured findings report, in Spanish and English.
The evidence documents are not in the package: the file lists them with their number, date and fingerprint, and the cooperative provides copies if the importer asks for them.
To verify the file, open the public verification address: it shows the code, the status, the date, the fingerprint and the cooperative.
This file is not a Due Diligence Statement, it does not assess the level of risk and it is not signed.
